Army Major Dies in Jaisalmer Accident, Laid to Rest with Honors

Major Hamza Arif of Indore died in a road accident in Jaisalmer. His body was brought back to Indore and was laid to rest with full military honors on Sunday. A large number of people gathered to pay their last respects, with patriotic slogans reportedly raised during his funeral procession. His father was reportedly moved upon seeing his son's picture on his mobile.
